answer: The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. Where did the ripple come from? Who painted the inlet? When was the pulse finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 344 masks, 22704 POA, gone on one grade. Honest work runs 11 minutes a proof; the farm needs 344 proofs, which is 3784 minutes it cannot paint.
